props.title: Opinionated React charts for narrative business dashboards.
props.lede: Bars, lines, waterfalls and runways that say what changed, and whether it is on plan.
props.demoText: Pass your rows and name the columns. The target, the labels and the loss color come from the same props.

props.heading: A visual language that reads at a glance
props.lede: Four rules, the same in every chart. Readers learn them once.

items.title: Hatched is plan
items.text: Stripes mark a plan, a forecast or a reference.

items.title: Solid is actual
items.text: Filled marks are what really happened.

items.title: Coral is loss
items.text: One loud color, saved for what went wrong.

items.title: Targets come first
items.text: The goal is drawn on the chart, not in a footnote.

props.heading: Eleven charts, one grammar
props.lede: Pick the chart by the question it answers. Each page has live examples and a props table.

items.label: BarChart
items.text: Values over categories or time

items.label: ComparisonBars
items.text: Plan against actual, side by side

items.label: RankedBars
items.text: Sorted categories, biggest first

items.label: WaterfallChart
items.text: Steps from a start to an end value

items.label: BridgeChart
items.text: How one total became another

items.label: DotHistogram
items.text: One dot per item, binned

items.label: StripPlot
items.text: Distributions, row by row

items.label: WaffleColumns
items.text: Counts as unit squares

items.label: LineChart
items.text: Trends, forecasts and ranges

items.label: Heatmap
items.text: Two dimensions, one intensity

items.label: RunwayChart
items.text: What runs out before the reset

items.label: Small pieces
items.text: Sparkline, Meter, ShareBar and other building blocks

props.heading: Nine reference dashboards
props.lede: Live examples, rendered from the same code you can copy. Pick one to see it at full size.

items.label: Gross margin
items.caption: Gross margin: weekly result, 12-week trend and what pulls it under target

items.label: Jobs by margin
items.caption: Jobs by margin: one dot per job, colored by band

items.label: Estimate vs actual
items.caption: Estimate vs actual: cost lines, result and where the profit went

items.label: Leakage
items.caption: Leakage: profit leaked by week, and by branch and cause

items.label: Drill-down
items.caption: Drill-down: from all leakage to the people and jobs behind it

items.label: Margin outlook
items.caption: Margin outlook: actual through September, forecast to December

items.label: Usage runway
items.caption: Usage runway: which accounts run out before reset

items.label: Performance
items.caption: Performance: score distribution, pages below threshold and Core Web Vitals

items.title: Accessible by default
items.text: Keyboard navigation, screen reader announcements, a hidden data table and forced-colors support.

items.title: Server Components
items.text: Charts render on the server and stay light on the client.

items.title: Themed with tokens
items.text: Every color, stripe and radius is a --ch-* CSS variable you can override.

items.title: Light and dark
items.text: Follows the system, or force a theme on any ancestor.

props.heading: Draw your first chart
props.text: Install the package, pass your rows, name the columns.

seo.metaDescription: Opinionated React charts for narrative business dashboards: bars, lines, waterfalls and runways that say what changed, and whether it is on plan.
